title_en: Shop Around and Take a Look
source_file: 多逛几家看一看（4-7 岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] ＄如果动物有钱了
多逛几家看一看
[美]夏洛特·丹著 [马来]亚当·荣绘 王思尧译
中信出版集团

[P2] 当我们买玩具、自行车、衣服，还有其他小玩意儿的时候，通常会选择最先看到的那件。这么做简单又省时，但这可不一定就是最好的选择哟！
在这个问题上，我们应该向奶牛学习。他在买东西之前会比较不同店铺的价格，然后做出最好的选择。

[P3] 比如有一次，奶牛想买一棵圣诞树。
为此他一天逛了三家店！
为了节省时间，他本可以在第一家商店就买，但他通过
比较不同卖家的价格，最终省下了好大一笔钱。他用这些钱
给妹妹买了个超棒的礼物！

[P4] 还有一次，奶牛想去滑雪，他需要一副新滑雪板。
奶牛十分有耐心，他在购买之前连续两周都在物色合适的滑雪板，最后才成功地买到了一副又便宜又好看的。这让他 的旅行快乐无比。

[P5] 最近，奶牛想学习烘焙芝士蛋糕。烘焙需要许多工具、原料以及设备，买这些要花一大笔钱！

奶牛花了好几周的时间到处逛街，购买他需要的东西。他买的帽子和烤箱折扣很多，所以省下了好大一笔钱！这下他想做多少个芝士蛋糕都没问题。

[P6] 奶牛从不浪费钱，也不会多花冤枉钱。多逛几家看一看的好习惯让他总是能用更少的钱买到自己喜欢的东西。
当然，奶牛并不是天生就会比较价格。事实上，他曾经花钱如流水。

[P7] 有一次，奶牛和家人一起去夏威夷度假。
他花光了自己所有的钱，只买了两个冲浪板做纪念品，但如果
多去几家店看看，他的钱足够给每个朋友买一个礼物。

[P8] 还有一次，奶牛的妈妈让他去买饼干、芹菜、苹果、芝士、酸奶，还有南瓜。

但奶牛回家时只买了饼干、芹菜和苹果，因为他一看到这些东西立马就拿去结账了，并没注意到还有其他更便宜的选择，所以很快他就把钱花光了。

[P9] 奶牛的问题出在哪里？他没有耐心，只想早点买完，然后和朋友们去玩。
这样一来，他就总想着花在购物上的时间越少越好，所以花了很多冤枉钱，有时甚至把钱花得精光。

[P10] 一天，奶牛的朋友狐狸看到他的午饭只有芹菜和苹果，感到很奇怪，这对于一只奶牛来说完全不够吃呀。

奶牛有气无力地告诉狐狸：“我每次去超市购物都会花光钱，所以就买不起丰盛的午餐了。”

[P11] 狐狸明白这是怎么回事。他发现奶牛做事太着急了，所以在购物的过程中浪费了很多钱。
狐狸告诉奶牛：“嘿，我觉得钱不够花是因为你没耐心。但想省钱也很容易，我教你‘10%规则’如何？”

[P12] “是这样的，当你购物的时候，看看想买的东西多少钱，然后再看看别的店铺有没有便宜 10% 的价格。就是这样！

“这其实相当简单。这个规则会让你习惯货比三家，可以把它当作一场游戏！‘10% 规则’ 会帮你找到价格更优惠的选择。有时候你可能省不到 10% 的钱，有时候可能会省 20% 的钱，重点在于，要不断尝试！”，

[P13] “我们来举个例子吧！当你在超市购物时使用‘10% 规则’，只要比较一下价格，省下的钱就足够买妈妈让你买的所有的东西。”
“记住，这是一场游戏。在你购物的时候，一定要记住运用‘10% 规则’。这不会花太长时间，还会让购物过程非常有趣，而且总能帮你省下钱。”

[P14] 奶牛兴奋极了。他已经过够了钱不够花、饭不够吃的日
子。货比三家就能解决这一切吗？
虽然有点难以置信，但奶牛喜欢游戏。他准备一有机会
就试试这个“10% 规则”。

[P15] 周一，奶牛妈妈又让他去购物。这一次他决定在买每个商品时都试试“10% 规则”。
营业
10%
90%
我的天哪！在货比三家后，奶牛省下了好多钱，他用这些钱给妈妈买了一大束花。

[P16] 又到周一了，奶牛又去购物了。这一次他想试试省下比上次更多的钱。
结果，他自己都惊呆了！货比三家让他省下了超多钱，他用这些钱给妈妈买了一大盒巧克力。省钱真是太棒了！

[P17] 很多跟钱有关的问题重点不在金钱本身，而在于我们对金钱的态度。
如果可以调整好自己的心态，按照“10% 规则”那样做，养成省钱的习惯会相当简单。
full_text_en:
[P1] $ If Animals Had Money
Take a Look at a Few More Stores
[US] Charlotte Dan, author [Malaysia] Adam Yong, illustrator, Wang Siyao, translator
Citic Publishing Group

[P2] When we buy toys, bicycles, clothes, and other little things, we usually choose the first one we see. This is simple and saves time, but it's not always the best choice!
On this issue, we should learn from the cow. He compares prices from different stores before buying something, and then makes the best choice.

[P3] For example, once, the cow wanted to buy a Christmas tree.
So he visited three stores in one day!
To save time, he could have bought it at the first store, but by
comparing prices from different sellers, he ultimately saved a big amount of money. He used that money
to buy a fantastic gift for his sister!

[P4] Once, the cow wanted to go skiing and needed a new pair of skis.
The cow was very patient. He spent two weeks looking for the right skis and finally bought a pair that was both cheap and nice. This made his trip absolutely joyful.

[P5] Recently, the cow wanted to learn how to bake cheese cakes. Baking requires many tools, ingredients, and equipment, and buying these would cost a lot of money!

The cow spent several weeks shopping around for what he needed. He got great discounts on his hat and oven, so he saved a big amount of money! Now he can make as many cheese cakes as he wants.

[P6] The cow never wastes money and doesn't spend unnecessarily. The habit of shopping around helps him always buy what he likes for less money.
Of course, the cow wasn't born knowing how to compare prices. In fact, he once spent money like water.

[P7] Once, the cow went on vacation to Hawaii with his family.
He spent all his money on just two surfboards as souvenirs, but if
he had visited a few more stores, his money would have been enough to buy a gift for each friend.

[P8] Once, Cow's mom asked him to buy cookies, celery, apples, cheese, yogurt, and pumpkins.

But when Cow got home, he had only bought cookies, celery, and apples, because he immediately grabbed them and went to pay, without noticing there were cheaper options available. So he quickly spent all his money.

[P9] What's the problem with the cow? He lacks patience and just wants to finish shopping quickly so he can go play with his friends.
As a result, he always wants to spend as little time shopping as possible, so he ends up spending a lot of money unnecessarily, and sometimes even spends all his money.

[P10] One day, the cow's friend, the fox, saw that his lunch consisted only of celery and an apple. He felt very strange—this was completely insufficient for a cow.

The cow weakly told the fox, "Every time I go shopping at the supermarket, I spend all my money, so I can't afford a hearty lunch."

[P11] The fox understood what was going on. He realized the cow was too impatient and had wasted a lot of money while shopping.
The fox told the cow: "Hey, I think you don't have enough money because you're impatient. But saving money is easy. Let me teach you the '10% Rule'. How about it?"

[P12] "It's like this: when you're shopping, check how much the item you want costs, then look at other stores to see if they have it for 10% cheaper. That's it!

"Actually, it's quite simple. This rule will help you get into the habit of comparing prices. You can think of it as a game! The '10% Rule' will help you find better deals. Sometimes you might save less than 10%, sometimes you might save 20%. The key is to keep trying!"

[P13] "Let's give an example! When you're shopping at the supermarket and use the '10% Rule', just compare the prices, and the money you save will be enough to buy everything your mom asked you to buy."
"Remember, this is a game. When you're shopping, be sure to use the '10% Rule'. It won't take too long, it will make shopping fun, and it will always help you save money."

[P14] The cow was very excited. He had had enough of days when he didn't have enough money or enough food. Could comparing prices solve all of this?
Although it was a bit hard to believe, the cow liked games. He was ready to try this "10% rule" as soon as he got the chance.

[P15] Monday, Cow's mom sent him shopping again. This time, he decided to try the '10% Rule' on every item he bought.
Open for Business
10%
90%
Wow! After comparing prices, Cow saved a lot of money. He used it to buy his mom a big bouquet of flowers.

[P16] It's Monday again, and the cow is going shopping. This time, he wants to try saving even more money than last time.
Result? He's amazed himself! Comparing prices saved him a ton of money, and he used it to buy his mom a big box of chocolate. Saving money is awesome!

[P17] Many problems related to money are not about money itself, but about our attitude toward money.
If you can adjust your mindset and follow the '10% Rule', developing a habit of saving money will be quite simple.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《多逛几家看一看》，副标题为《如果动物有钱了》，展示了一头戴围巾的奶牛站在图表背景前，左右手各举一个商品，象征比较购物。下方标注了作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页通过奶牛使用电脑比较价格的场景，对比了人们常因方便而选择第一件商品的习惯，强调应像奶牛一样货比三家，做出更优选择。
[P3] 本页通过奶牛为买圣诞树而逛三家店的例子，说明他通过货比三家节省了大量金钱，并用省下的钱为妹妹买了礼物，进一步强调了比较购物的益处。
[P4] 本页讲述了奶牛为了滑雪而购买滑雪板的故事，他耐心地花了两周时间比较选择，最终买到既便宜又好看的滑雪板，使他的旅行充满快乐。
[P5] 奶牛想学习烘焙芝士蛋糕，但需要购买工具和设备，花费不菲。他花了数周时间货比三家，以折扣价购得所需物品，节省了大量金钱，从而可以尽情制作芝士蛋糕。
[P6] 本页通过文字和插图说明奶牛因养成货比三家的习惯而能省钱，同时指出他并非天生如此，也曾有过挥霍的经历。
[P7] 本页通过奶牛在夏威夷度假时花光所有钱只买两个冲浪板做纪念品的例子，说明他过去曾因不货比三家而挥霍，与现在省钱的习惯形成对比。
[P8] 奶牛的妈妈让他买多种食材，但他只买了部分商品，因未货比三家而很快花光了钱。
[P9] 本页解释了奶牛过去购物时因缺乏耐心、急于完成购物而导致花钱多甚至花光钱的问题，与他现在货比三家的习惯形成对比。
[P10] 奶牛的朋友狐狸发现他午饭只有芹菜和苹果，感到奇怪，奶牛解释说自己每次购物都会花光钱，因此买不起丰盛的午餐。
[P11] 狐狸意识到奶牛因做事太着急而在购物中浪费钱，于是决定教他省钱的‘10%规则’。
[P12] 狐狸向奶牛解释‘10%规则’，即购物时寻找比原价便宜10%的选项，以养成货比三家的习惯并省钱。
[P13] 狐狸向奶牛举例说明如何在超市使用‘10%规则’省钱，并强调这像一场有趣的游戏，能帮助节省开支。
[P14] 奶牛对狐狸提出的‘10%规则’感到兴奋，认为这或许能解决他钱不够花的问题，并决定尝试这个省钱方法。
[P15] 奶牛在周一购物时决定实践狐狸教的“10%规则”，通过货比三家成功省钱，并用省下的钱为妈妈买了一大束花。
[P16] 奶牛在周一再次购物，尝试比上次省更多钱，结果通过货比三家省下大量钱，并用省下的钱为妈妈买了一大盒巧克力，感到非常开心。
[P17] 狐狸向奶牛解释，省钱的关键在于调整心态，而非金钱本身，并强调遵循‘10%规则’能轻松养成省钱习惯。画面中狐狸牵着奶牛，象征引导其克服情绪障碍。
